name: Anime
description: Integrates Anime.js, is a lightweight JavaScript animation library with a simple, yet powerful API.
library_dependencies: animejs (juliangarnier/anime) 3.2.2 — placed at /libraries/anime/lib/anime.min.js, or auto-loaded from cdnjs when absent
project_description: The Anime module is a thin integration layer that makes the Anime.js JavaScript animation library available to a Drupal site. Anime.js is a lightweight animation engine that works with CSS properties, SVG, DOM attributes and plain JavaScript objects through a single unified API. The module attaches the library globally on every page (via hook_page_attachments), preferring a locally installed copy at /libraries/anime/lib/anime.min.js and falling back to the anime.js 3.2.2 build on cdnjs when no local copy is present. It ships no routes, no permissions, no settings form, no services and no plugins — its whole job is to load the library so that a theme's or module's own JavaScript can call anime(). A companion 'anime_ui' module is referenced (when present it takes over asset loading), but it is not part of this package. A status-report requirement reports whether the library is installed locally or served from the CDN, and a detected version string parsed from the library file.
